blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A magnitude 5.8 earthquake jolted the waters off Surigao Del Norte on Sunday evening, state seismologists reported. According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), the earthquake, which was tectonic in origin, occurred at 9:41 p.m. Its epicenter was located 35 kilometers southeast of General Luna, Surigao del Norte, with a depth of 10 kilometers.
